data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of $4.3 million in 2016. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development in older underwriting years, particularly in short-tail Property classes which benefited from a relatively low level of catastrophe events despite absorbing losses from Hurricane Odile. However, the 2014 year of account also saw adverse development from notable risk losses on the Energy account and a SpaceX satellite loss on the Specie & Cargo account. The overall 2016 calendar year results were impacted by current year adverse loss activity including Hurricane Matthew, an increase in US designated catastrophes (flood and hail), and a SpaceX satellite loss.
raw_causal_phrases: The short tail Property classes contributed significantly to this profit. These classes benefited from a relatively low level of catastrophe events despite absorbing losses from Hurricane Odile.
There were two other notable risk losses on the Energy account and the SpaceX satellite loss on the Specie & Cargo account.
Loss activity reflects Hurricane Matthew, an increase in US designated catastrophes, notably in respect of flood and hail losses, and the SpaceX satellite.

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 24 states a net prior year release of $3.362 million, while the gross claims development triangle on page 22 indicates a gross prior year release of $4.3 million. The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions. LOB movements are qualitative as no quantified amounts were provided.
